title: The five-rung IR ladder
subtitle: every artifact climbs the same ladder, so passes from different ecosystems compose through one .dr envelope

rungs.label: Raw
rungs.detail: the input file, format fingerprinted from internal self-consistency, not a single magic byte

rungs.label: Disasm
rungs.detail: format-specific decode: CPython, Dalvik, CIL, Wasm, YARV, JS AST, native x86

rungs.label: MIR
rungs.detail: ecosystem-neutral mid IR where deobfuscation passes run: unflatten, MBA-fold, devirtualize

rungs.label: HIR
rungs.detail: structured high IR: loops, conditionals, and expressions recovered from the control-flow graph

rungs.label: Surface
rungs.detail: rendered source, verified against an independent oracle, never the tool's own output

footnote: Recovery is reported at the highest rung reached. A wall is named at the rung it stops on, with the reason: runtime-only key, native-VM handler stream, or a source body the compiler discarded.
